pages.title: Admissions FAQs
pages.content:
Admissions

Frequently Asked Questions

What age does Crèche accept?
Our Crèche accepts infants from 6 months to 2 years, in a safe, nurturing environment staffed by trained caregivers.
Is there an entrance exam?
Yes, for Primary and Secondary entry, students complete an age-appropriate entrance assessment as part of the admissions process.
Do you offer scholarships?
Merit-based scholarships are available for outstanding students. Contact our admissions office for eligibility criteria.
Is transportation provided?
School bus services are available for select routes across Lagos. Contact your campus office for route information.

pages.title: Founder's Note
pages.content:
About Us

Founder's Note

Founder's Note

When we opened our first classroom in 1977, we had no way of knowing that a single act of faith would grow into a legacy spanning generations. Our founding vision was simple: every child deserves an education that nurtures both mind and character.

Today, as I reflect on 48 years of Chrisland Schools, I am filled with gratitude — for the teachers who poured themselves into their students, for the parents who trusted us with their children's futures, and for the thousands of alumni now shining as leaders across the world.

Our motto, "Show Forth The Light," remains as true today as it was in 1977. We remain committed to raising children who will illuminate every space they enter — in Nigeria and beyond.

pages.title: History
pages.content:
About Us

Our History

Our History

Chrisland Schools was founded in 1977 with a single classroom and a bold vision — to raise children of character who would light the way for generations to come. What began as a small nursery school in Lagos has grown into one of Nigeria's most respected private educational institutions.

Over the decades, Chrisland has expanded across multiple campuses, welcoming tens of thousands of students from Crèche through Sixth Form. Our founders believed that quality education paired with strong moral values could transform not just individual lives, but entire communities.

Milestones

  • 1977 — Chrisland Nursery and Primary School founded in Ikeja, Lagos
  • 1985 — Chrisland Secondary School opens its doors
  • 1998 — Expansion to additional campuses across Lagos
  • 2010 — Introduction of the Cambridge International curriculum
  • 2025 — Celebrating 48 years of educational excellence

"We did not set out to build a school. We set out to build people who would show forth the light wherever they went."

— Chrisland Founders

pages.title: Managing Director's Note
pages.content:
About Us

Managing Director's Note

Managing Director's Note

Leading Chrisland Schools into its next chapter is both an honour and a responsibility I do not take lightly. Our founders built something extraordinary, and my commitment is to ensure that legacy continues to grow — academically, culturally, and technologically.

In recent years, we have invested heavily in modernising our facilities, expanding our curriculum offerings, and embracing new tools like AI-assisted learning to prepare our students for a rapidly changing world. Yet through all this change, our core values remain constant: excellence, integrity, and compassion.

I invite you to visit our campuses, meet our teachers, and see firsthand why families across Nigeria continue to choose Chrisland for their children's education.

School Pledge

"We, the students of Chrisland Schools, pledge to show forth the light of knowledge, integrity, and compassion in all that we do. We commit to excellence in learning, respect for one another, and service to our community and nation."

School Anthem

Our school anthem is sung at every assembly, reminding students of the values and legacy they carry as members of the Chrisland family — a tradition passed down since 1977.

Admission Requirements

Crèche & Nursery

  • Completed application form
  • Birth certificate
  • Immunisation records
  • Passport photographs

Primary & Secondary

  • Completed application form
  • Previous school report / transcript
  • Entrance assessment (age-appropriate)
  • Birth certificate and passport photographs

Sixth Form

About Us

Safeguarding

Safeguarding

The safety and wellbeing of every Chrisland student is our highest priority. We maintain rigorous safeguarding standards across all campuses, in line with national and international best practices.

Our Commitments

  • Background-checked and vetted staff at every campus
  • Dedicated Safeguarding Officers on every campus
  • Clear reporting channels for concerns
  • Regular safeguarding training for all staff
  • Secure campus access and visitor protocols

If you have a safeguarding concern, please contact your campus Safeguarding Officer immediately or reach out through our Contact page.
